'''Gavid Lermyn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked as a [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Lermyn was a well known figure in the [[Thaereian system|Thaere system]] and he publicly declaimed the aggressive actions of the [[Thaereian military]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. As a result, the military planned to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Lermyn, but due to his publicity they could not do so overtly, so they planned to have him [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]], and frame the Thaereian deserter [[Osten Dal'Nay]] for the crime. The military dispatched Lermyn to the [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] system, supposedly to act as a negotiator to gain some trade concessions from Cularin, and they planned to have the assassination take place while he was on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. However, the [[Heroes of Cularin]] foiled the plot to kill him.
